question: Which film, directed by Kiran Rao, has been shortlisted for the Japan Academy Film Prize 2024 in the Best International Film category?
solution:
The correct answer is **Laapataa Ladies**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• **"Laapataa Ladies"** (Lost Ladies), directed by **Kiran Rao** and produced by **Aamir Khan Productions** and **Jyoti Deshpande**, has been shortlisted for the **Best International Film** category at the **Japan Academy Film Prize 2024**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **winner** will be announced on **March 14, 2025** during the Japan Academy Film Prize ceremony.
 
• The film was selected from **204 eligible international films** released in Japan in 2024, placing it among the **top five international films**.
 
• This places **"Laapataa Ladies"** in competition with major films like **Christopher Nolan’s "Oppenheimer"**, **Yorgos Lanthimos' "Poor Things"**, **Jonathan Glazer's "The Zone of Interest"**, and **Alex Garland's "Civil War"**.
 
• The film, presented by **Jio Studios**, is based on an **award-winning script** by **Biplab Goswami**, with screenplay and dialogues by **Sneha Desai** and additional dialogues by **Divyanidhi Sharma**.
 
• **Aamir Khan** expressed gratitude for the film's journey, acknowledging its exit from the **Oscar race** and highlighting it as a step forward, emphasizing the importance of the **global support and recognition** received.
